chapter.title: Chapter 10
paragraphs: It is a truth universally acknowledged.
That a single man in possession of a good fortune must be in want of a wife.
However little known the feelings or views of such a man may be on his first entering a neighbourhood.
This truth is so well fixed in the minds of the surrounding families.

memo.core_thesis: Pride and Prejudice's opening — a famous ironic thesis.
reading_anchors: It is a truth universally acknowledged

comments.content: The novel's opening sentence is one of the most parodied in English.
Note that the grammar is deliberately inverted — Austen treats the proposition as obvious.
